messages: I hear Dr. #p308# has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.

I visited Dr. #p308# again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take #b20 #t4000011#s#k, #b15 pieces of #t4000015##k, #b1 #t4031075##k, and #b1 pair of #t1032002##k, it'd make Dr. #p512# very happy.

I delivered Dr. #p308#'s #t4031074# to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Along with the report, I also gave him the #t4000011#, #t4000015#, #t4031075#, and #t1032002#. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the #t1032015#.
name: Progress on Fossil Research
